title: SMP: A General Hyperedge-Based Framework for Circuit-Level Quantum Error Correction
summary: Hyperedge faults remain a major challenge in circuit-level quantum error correction. Accurately exploiting hyperedge correlations often requires substantial computational resources, which complicates real-time decoding. Matching-based decoders are fast and scalable, but their pairwise graph representation limits the use of higher-order fault information. Here, we introduce Syndrome Motif Projection (SMP), a general framework for incorporating hyperedge information into matching-based decoding.
